# Load Packages

```{r}
library(MatrixEQTL)
library(data.table)
```

# Define Function

```{r}
run_matrix_eqtl <- function(SNP_file, expression_file, cov_file, outfile_cis, outfile_trans){
  # 1. Set general parameters
  # Use linear model (other models: modelANOVA, modelLINEAR, or modelLINEAR_CROSS)
  useModel <- modelLINEAR
  # We need to set up the p-value cutoff and the error model (in this case assuming independent errors)
  # Only associations significant at this level will be saved
  pvOutputThreshold_cis = 5e-2  # cis-eQTLS cutoff: 0.05
  pvOutputThreshold_tra = 0  # no trans-eQTLs
  # Error covariance matrix: set to numeric() for identity
  errorCovariance <- numeric()
  # Distance for local (cis) gene-SNP pairs
  cisDist = 1e6  # cis window of 1Mb = 1e6, 100kb = 1e5
  
  # 2. Set Data Up
  # Now we need to set up the snp and gene expression data in the special format required by the MatrixEQTL package
  # 2.1 SNP Data
  snps = SlicedData$new()
  snps$fileDelimiter <- "\t"     # the TAB character
  snps$fileOmitCharacters <- "NA" # denote missing values;
  snps$fileSkipRows <- 1          # one row of column labels
  snps$fileSkipColumns <- 1       # one column of row labels
  snps$fileSliceSize <- 100000     # read file in pieces of 100,000 rows
  snps$LoadFile(SNP_file)
  # 2.2 Gene Expression Data
  gene <- SlicedData$new()
  gene$fileDelimiter <- "\t"      # the TAB character
  gene$fileOmitCharacters <- "NA" # denote missing values;
  gene$fileSkipRows <- 1          # one row of column labels
  gene$fileSkipColumns <- 1      # one column of row labels
  gene$fileSliceSize <- 2000      # read file in pieces of 2,000 rows
  gene$LoadFile(expression_file)
  # 2.3 Covariates
  cvrt <- SlicedData$new()
  cvrt$fileDelimiter = "\t"      # the TAB character
  cvrt$fileOmitCharacters = "NA" # denote missing values;
  cvrt$fileSkipRows = 1          # one row of column labels
  cvrt$fileSkipColumns = 1       # one column of row labels
  if(length(cov_file) > 0){
    cvrt$LoadFile(cov_file)  # read file if given
  }
  
  # 3. Run Matrix_eQTL
  # Gene Expr x SNP
  me = Matrix_eQTL_main(
    snps = snps, 
    gene = gene, 
    cvrt = cvrt,
    output_file_name = outfile_trans,
    pvOutputThreshold = pvOutputThreshold_tra , #pvOutputThreshold_tra only cis
    useModel = useModel, 
    errorCovariance = errorCovariance, 
    verbose = TRUE, 
    output_file_name.cis = outfile_cis,
    pvOutputThreshold.cis = pvOutputThreshold_cis,
    snpspos = snpspos, 
    genepos = genepos,
    cisDist = cisDist,
    pvalue.hist = "qqplot",
    min.pv.by.genesnp = FALSE,
    noFDRsaveMemory = FALSE)
  return(me)
}
```

# Load SNP And Gene Positions

As we need the SNP and gene position for all matrixEQTL runs, we will load them in the beginning, so that we do not have to repeat this step over and over again.

```{r}
# MatrixEQTL does not work without giving the tool the SNP and gene position. 
snpspos <- read.table("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/SNP_locations.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t") # snp chr pos
head(snpspos)
genepos <- read.table("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/gene_locations.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t") # geneid chr start end
genepos <- genepos[!is.na(genepos$start), ]  # remove NA's
head(genepos)
```


# Example Data From MatrixEQTL

```{r}
# 1. Get Files
base.dir <- find.package("MatrixEQTL")
SNP_file_name <- paste(base.dir, "/data/SNP.txt", sep = "");
expression_file_name <- paste(base.dir, "/data/GE.txt", sep="")
covariates_file_name <- paste(base.dir, "/data/Covariates.txt", sep="")
output_file_name <- tempfile()

# 2. Load And Inspect Data
# Gene expression data
expr <- read.table(expression_file_name, sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1) # get first line: expr[1, ]
head(expr)
# Genotype (SNP) data
geno <- read.table(SNP_file_name, sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1) # get first line: snps[1, ]
head(geno)
# Covariates
cov <- read.table(covariates_file_name, sep = "\t", header = T, row.names = 1)
cov

# 3. Set general Parameters
# We need to set up the p-value cutoff and the error model (in this case assuming independent errors).
pvOutputThreshold <- 1e-2
errorCovariance <- numeric()
useModel <- modelLINEAR

# 4. Set data up
# Now we need to set up the snp and gene expression data in the special format required by the MatrixEQTL package.
# 4.1 SNP data
snps = SlicedData$new()
snps$fileDelimiter <- "\t"     # the TAB character
snps$fileOmitCharacters <- "NA" # denote missing values;
snps$fileSkipRows <- 1          # one row of column labels
snps$fileSkipColumns <- 1       # one column of row labels
snps$fileSliceSize <- 2000     # read file in pieces of 2,000 rows
snps$LoadFile(SNP_file_name)

# 4.2 Gene expression data
gene <- SlicedData$new()
gene$fileDelimiter <- "\t"      # the TAB character
gene$fileOmitCharacters <- "NA" # denote missing values;
gene$fileSkipRows <- 1          # one row of column labels
gene$fileSkipColumns <- 1      # one column of row labels
gene$fileSliceSize <- 2000      # read file in pieces of 2,000 rows
gene$LoadFile(expression_file_name)

# 4.3 Covariates
cvrt = SlicedData$new();
cvrt$fileDelimiter = "\t";      # the TAB character
cvrt$fileOmitCharacters = "NA"; # denote missing values;
cvrt$fileSkipRows = 1;          # one row of column labels
cvrt$fileSkipColumns = 1;       # one column of row labels
if(length(covariates_file_name) > 0) {
  cvrt$LoadFile(covariates_file_name);
}

# 5. Run MatrixEQTL
me <- Matrix_eQTL_engine(
    snps = snps,
    gene = gene,
    cvrt = cvrt,
    output_file_name = NULL,
    pvOutputThreshold = pvOutputThreshold,
    useModel = useModel, 
    errorCovariance = errorCovariance, 
    verbose = TRUE,
    pvalue.hist = TRUE,
    min.pv.by.genesnp = FALSE,
    noFDRsaveMemory = FALSE);

#  6. Understand results
# We can make a plot of all the p-values from the tests:
plot(me)

# We can also look at the number and type of eQTL:
me$all$neqtls
me$all$eqtls
```

# Calculate eQTLS For Complete Data (SCZ + AFF + CTL)

## Get Files

First, we will save the file names for the different datasets we need for the matrixEQTL function/package.

```{r}
# Genotype (SNP) file name
SNP_file_name_all <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/01_pmb_snps_SCZ_CTL.txt"

# Gene expression file name
expression_file_name_all <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/01_pmb_gene_expr_SCZ_CTL.txt"

# Covariates file name
covariates_file_name_all <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/01_pmb_cov_SCZ_CTL.txt"

# Output file name
output_file_name_cis_all <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/results/01_pmb_SCZ_CTL_matrixEQTL_cis_results.txt"
output_file_name_trans_all <- "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/results/01_pmb_SCZ_CTL_matrixEQTL_trans_results.txt"
```

## Load And Inspect Data

Load the data and check if it is in the right format.

```{r, eval = F}

load("/storage/groups/ccm01/karolina/Desktop/PhD/MPIP/workspace/RData_Files/4_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_gene_summaries_annotated_combat_batch_corrected.RData")

# Gene expression data
expr <- fread(expression_file_name_all, sep = "\t", header = T) # get first line: expr[1, ]
head(expr)

# Genotype (SNP) data
snps <- fread(SNP_file_name_all, sep = "\t", header = T) # get first line: snps[1, ]
head(snps)

# Covariates
cova <- fread(covariates_file_name_all, sep = "\t", header = T)

# Delete files again
#rm(expr, snps, cova)
scz <- rbind(data.matrix(cova[cova$rn == "DxAFF", ]), scz <- data.matrix(cova[cova$rn == "DxSCZ", ]))
scz <- as.data.frame(colSums(scz))
scz["rn", "colSums(scz)"] <- "Dx"
cova <- cova[!cova$rn %in% c("DxAFF", "DxSCZ"), ] # remove DxAFF and DxSCZ rows
cova <- rbind(cova, t(scz)) # add Dx (scz) row
write.table(cova, "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/01_pmb_cov_SCZ_AFF_CTL.txt", row.names = F, sep = "\t", quote = F)
```

### Run MatrixEQTL

```{r}
me.all <- run_matrix_eqtl(SNP_file = SNP_file_name_all, expression_file = expression_file_name_all, cov_file = covariates_file_name_all, outfile_cis = output_file_name_cis_all, outfile_trans = output_file_name_trans_all)
```

### Results

Found 3,963,137 cis-eQTLs. No trans-eQTLs.
 
```{r}
cat('Analysis done in: ', me.all$time.in.sec, ' seconds', '\n');
#cat('Detected local eQTLs:', '\n');
#show(me.all$cis$eqtls)
#cat('Detected distant eQTLs:', '\n');
#show(me.all$trans$eqtls)

## Plot the Q-Q plot of local and distant p-values
plot(me.all)

# Save matrixEQTL output to RData file
save(me.all, file = "/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/results/01_pmb_SCZ_AFF_CTL_matrixEQTL.RData")
```
